title: Music Fireball
description: A 3D-printed gaming ball designed to help school teenagers socialize with each other, spend less time on their phones and be more active.

title: Obstacle Detection with RealSense
description: Real-time obstacle detection and avoidance pipeline built with OpenCV and an Intel RealSense depth camera.
details: Combines RGB-D data from a RealSense camera with OpenCV processing to segment obstacles and feed a reactive avoidance layer, tested on a small differential-drive platform.

title: IoT Environmental Monitor
description: A custom PCB with temperature, humidity, and air-quality sensors that streams readings to the cloud.
details: Designed a two-layer PCB around a low-power microcontroller, wrote the embedded C firmware, and set up an AWS IoT pipeline to log and visualize sensor readings.
